Install and maintain groundwater monitoring wells/instrumentation

jobs.description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a trillion dollar industry that still runs on manual work. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings by hand, and it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates so bids get done 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and revenue is doubling quarter over quarter.

About The Role

As our first data hire, you will lay the foundation for our company-wide data architecture and analytics strategy. You will design, build, and maintain our data pipeline and warehousing infrastructure, centralize fragmented data sources, and establish reliable metric definitions across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional leadership to deliver actionable insights, build high-impact dashboards, and enable data-informed decision-making at every level of the business.

What You'll Do

Architect, scale, and maintain our central data warehouse and scalable ELT/ETL pipelines across internal systems
Design robust data models and data transformation layers to turn raw operational data into clean, production-ready datasets
Establish, document, and standardize core business metrics and KPIs to ensure organizational alignment
Deliver executive- and operational-level reporting, performance tracking, and analytical models for company leadership
Develop intuitive BI dashboards and self-service analytics tools for teams across business operations, product, and strategy
Partner directly with key stakeholders across departments to identify analytical needs and answer strategic business questions
Write clean, efficient, and well-tested SQL and code to automate ingestion, data quality monitoring, and reporting
Implement automated data validation, quality assurance tests, and governance practices as our data ecosystem matures

What We're Looking For

5+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, or business intelligence
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL and hands-on data modeling with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Python for ETL and ELT work — API pulls, scripts, scheduled jobs
You've built a data warehouse and its pipelines from scratch at a company under a few hundred people
Real fluency in a B2B revenue funnel — you know what pipeline, CAC, and net revenue retention mean and why they move
You can define a metric, defend the definition, and get a sales leader to adopt it

Nice to have

BigQuery or a GCP data stack
HubSpot as a source system
Experience building financial or data controls, or supporting a SOC 2 audit
You were the first data hire somewhere before

What We Offer

$140K–$160K base + equity
Medical, dental, and vision, and a 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
The whole data function to build, with the CEO reading what you ship
On-site in SF at 101 Second Street — we build together

Comp Philosophy

We are proud to offer competitive, top-of-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance-based rewards.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

You will perform full range of analyses for a wide variety of requests, including very difficult, complex, or unusual assignments for atmospheric, oceanic, or other technical assessments.
You will develop and implement improved numerical models and analyses at all levels of classification.
You will develop, implement, upgrade, evaluate and maintain automated systems to acquire, decode, and quality control of all types of METOC data to maximize the value of satellite data and imagery for environmental models and tactical products.
You will present scientific results in a general public forum or produce a technical document for inter-agency distribution.

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov

This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
You will be required to obtain and maintain a U.S. Passport.
This is a Cyberspace Workforce position, work role code (624), proficiency level (BASIC) the incumbent is required to obtain and maintain qualifications in DoDM 8140.03 Cyber Workforce Qualification and Department of Navy policies.
This position is subject to work an uncommon tour, including nights, weekends, and holidays to meet mission requirements. Overtime or night differential pay and/or unusual duty hours may be required.

Qualifications

GS-12:

Your Resume Must Also Demonstrate At Least One Year Of Specialized Experience At Or Equivalent To The GS-11 Grade Level Or Pay Band In The Federal Service Or Equivalent Experience In The Private Or Public Sector. Specialized Experience Must Demonstrate The Following

Experience with an advanced programming language such as FORTRAN, or other languages requiring compilation of software code.
Experience with principles, theories, and practices of a combination of physical sciences, meteorology, oceanography, space, and computer science sufficient to adapt precedents, make significant departures from previous approaches, accommodate unique requirements, and to determine methods to use in evaluating and interpreting significant results.
Experience with software engineering techniques as applied to the development and maintenance of automated, real-time systems.
Experience with quality control systems such as Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) or Physical Sciences methodologies or modeling techniques.
Experience developing and modifying analytical methods to make determinations, including responding to complex technical questions or solving unprecedented problems.

Gs-11

Experience with computer programming languages such as C, C++, PYTHON, PERL/KORN SHELL, WEB SOFTWARE, and an advanced operating system such as LINUX.

Degree: physical science, engineering, or mathematics that included 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science such as mechanics, dynamics, properties of materials, and electronics. or

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

A Day in the Life

As an LDAR Field Technician, you’ll be responsible for performing inspections on various types of facilities in the Oil and Gas Industry to identify and quantify hydrocarbon gas leaks and vents.

The compensation range for this role is $20-22/hr. Commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.

To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities:

Assisting in coordinating and navigating to various facilities with maps and GPS
Helping to calibrate and maintain equipment
Using various detection and measurement technologies under the supervision of the Team Lead
Collecting and recording emission data
Preparing field reports as required

Effective computer skills (Excel and Microsoft Office are essential) and proficiency with Android OS
Ability to work 12-hour shifts (days only)

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder
will be a member of the S&OP/S&OE technical enablement team supporting NCoder, Nordstrom's network volume planning product within Supply Chain Network Throughput Planning. NCoder transforms cross-functional enterprise plans and forecasts into warehouse-level volume plans across six connected Anaplan models — Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, and Task, staged through a central DataHub — informing operational resource decisions across Nordstrom's distribution centers, fulfillment centers, and stores. The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder
will own the design, build, and maintenance of NCoder's Anaplan models, partnering closely with Supply Chain planners and engineering to keep the platform scalable, well-governed, and aligned to evolving business needs.

A day in the life…

Design, build, and maintain modules, dashboards, and calculation logic across NCoder's Anaplan models (Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, Task)
Partner with Supply Chain planners and product/engineering leads to translate volume-planning requirements into scalable Anaplan model designs
Manage and troubleshoot data connections between Anaplan and DataHub, the central staging layer that receives all external data from BigQuery via Airflow import DAGs
Maintain the model sequence and dependencies across Workstream 1 (Inbound → DC Outbound → Store Inbound) and Workstream 2 (Returns, running independently), both feeding the downstream Task model
Optimize models for performance and usability as planning cadence, data volume, and new workflows (e.g., fulfillment, last mile) come online
Document model logic, data flows, and business rules to support governance, onboarding, and audit needs
Partner with data engineering on BigQuery source/destination tables and Airflow DAG issues that affect model refreshes
Train and support Supply Chain planners and downstream consumers (Warehouse Ops, Transportation, Store Ops, SC Finance) on using NCoder models
Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop to accelerate model documentation, testing, and workflow automation

You own this if you have…

Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
3-5+ years building and maintaining Anaplan models; Anaplan Certified Model Builder (Level 3) or equivalent preferred
Strong understanding of Anaplan architecture: modules, lists, hierarchies, actions, dashboards, hub-and-spoke model design
Experience with data integration/ETL — BigQuery, Airflow-orchestrated pipelines, or similar
Comfortable with SQL for querying source and destination tables
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured technical model designs
Supply chain domain experience preferred (DC/FC/store operations, inbound/outbound logistics, returns, or labor/task planning)
Comfortable presenting to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Wetland Delineator/Environmental Scientist for our Cincinnati, Columbus, Cleveland, Dayton, Akron, Toledo or other regional offices.

Your Impact

Assist with planning and execution of wetland delineations and stream assessments for linear and renewable energy projects in the Midwest.
Perform duties as a wetland field team lead in accordance with current USACE 1987 Manual and Regional Supplements. Potential to support other natural resource surveys as needed.
Understand how to operate a GPS unit to collect field data, map habitat types and sensitive resources.
Support preparation of field equipment, mapping, Safe Work Plans, and logistics for field work.
Perform data entry, data analysis and report compilation.
Assist with various governmental agency coordination (USFWS, USACE, EPA, etc.).
Assist and lead preparation of wetland delineation reports, and permit applications for federal and/or state environmental permits, including USACE Section 404 and Section 10, state wetland and stream permits, NPDES, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service coordination, and state natural heritage agency coordination.
Field projects may require long hours and/or be physically demanding, and may require being on foot 10-12 hours per day traversing various topography while carrying equipment in varying weather conditions.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience conducting wetland delineations and stream assessments, preferably in Ohio and surrounding states.
Bachelors of Arts or Bachelors of Science degree in Environmental Science, Ecology, Environmental Studies, Biology or related field.
Familiarity with USACE wetland data forms, ORAM wetland data forms, and QHEI and HHEI stream data forms.
Experience with GPS field data collection.
Plant identification of Midwest vegetation.
Willingness to learn and implement various field methods for collection of data.
Proficient with data management, organization and MS Office Suite.
Attention and commitment to timely completion of high-quality work, often independently motivated.
Flexibility and adaptability to meet fast-paced demands.
Willing to work long hours in the field for possibly two weeks out of the month or more during peak periods of fieldwork.
High level of motivation and an ability to work as a team lead or independently as part of various teams.
